checkedAlternates.risk: Tetsubin resembles a teapot with a spout and handle.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A traditional Tetsubin is a bare cast-iron kettle used to boil water over heat (group-1), not a clay/porcelain vessel for steeping loose leaves (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: A Gaiwan is a bowl used in Asian tea rituals like a Chawan.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A Gaiwan is a small lidded Chinese steeping vessel for whole-leaf gongfu tea (group-4), whereas a Chawan is an open Japanese bowl for whisking powdered matcha (group-3).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
